body:
## What happened

Upgrading `go.temporal.io/api` from `v1.62.11` → `v1.62.12` (or newer) while using `go.temporal.io/sdk v1.43.0` causes a panic at `init()` time in any binary or test that imports both:

```
panic: proto: file "temporal/api/sdk/v1/external_storage.proto" has a name conflict over temporal.api.sdk.v1.ExternalStorage...
previously from: "go.temporal.io/sdk/internal/temporalapi/sdk/v1"
currently from:  "go.temporal.io/api/sdk/v1"
See https://protobuf.dev/reference/go/faq#namespace-conflict
```

## Root cause

`go.temporal.io/sdk v1.43.0` vendors its own copy of `external_storage.proto` at `internal/temporalapi/sdk/v1/external_storage.pb.go`. `go.temporal.io/api` added the same proto file in `v1.62.12` at `sdk/v1/external_storage.pb.go`.

Both packages register the file via `protoregistry.GlobalFiles.RegisterFile` during package init, and Go's protobuf registry requires globally unique file names — so any program importing both panics before `main` runs.

## Reproduction

`go.mod`:

```
require (
    go.temporal.io/api v1.62.12
    go.temporal.io/sdk v1.43.0
)
```

Any test or binary importing the SDK panics immediately at startup.

## Impact

- Forces consumers to pin `go.temporal.io/api <= v1.62.11`.
- Blocks routine dependency upgrades; in our monorepo, 80+ packages failed in 0.00s — all from this single init panic.

## Suggested fix

Drop the vendored `internal/temporalapi/sdk/v1/external_storage.pb.go` from the SDK and depend on the public `go.temporal.io/api/sdk/v1` package, or rename the internal proto's file path so the two no longer collide in `protoregistry`.

## Environment

- `go.temporal.io/sdk`: v1.43.0 (latest)
- `go.temporal.io/api`: v1.62.12
- Go: 1.26.3

comments.body:
Opened #2343 with the fix.

It follows the exact migration described in `internal/temporalapi/README.md`: delete the vendored `internal/temporalapi/` directory, repoint the two `sdkpb` imports in `internal/extstore/` to `go.temporal.io/api/sdk/v1`, and bump `go.temporal.io/api` to v1.62.12.

Verified locally:
- `go build ./...` and `go test [-race] ./internal/extstore/...` pass (51/51).
- A scratch module importing both `go.temporal.io/api v1.62.12` and the patched SDK no longer panics at `init()`.

title: proto namespace conflict: SDK vendors external_storage.proto already present in go.temporal.io/api v1.62.12+
